correctness.rationale: PASS: In the bidirected signed double-cover GLMY complex, backtrack two-path boundaries impose reversed-arc relations and reduce C1 to the σ-twisted edge incidence Bσ. The kernel of the forbidden-shortcut part of the two-path boundary is generated by pairwise same-shortcut differences; its allowed boundaries span exactly the balanced three- and four-cycle signed circulations. Therefore H1≅ker(Bσ)/Rσ. On a cactus the short cycles are edge-disjoint, Rσ has dimension kσ, while Bσ has rank |V|−bσ, proving β0=bσ and β1=|E|−|V|+bσ−kσ for all finite signed cacti including isolated vertices. In a fixed-vertex inherited-sign edge filtration, no later relation can kill a preexisting supported cycle, so degree-one maps are injective, degree-zero maps surjective. Signed edge/vertex, balanced component potentials, and short-cycle orientation lines yield the exact automorphism trace by short-exact-sequence additivity. For an all-negative friendship cactus F_m the trace is #fixed arms−1, the standard S_m module. Independent exact signed-double-cover boundary computation corroborated 200 graph/sign cases across six cactus families including signed C3, C4, C5, two triangles, square with tail and disconnected components; infinite theorem rests on edge-disjoint support proof.
